learning_outcomes.text: Acquire competencies in material selection and the necessary technology for their manufacturing.
Acquire knowledge in materials engineering development, enabling the learning of new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Express and communicate ideas and systems related to material technology.
Understand and prepare professional technical documentation, in the context of activities related to material technology.
Master the concepts of materials with their various treatments and their relationship and influence with related aspects of Engineering.
Master calculations and estimation and design procedures in matters of materials, production, and manufacturing.
Know the essential properties of metallic, polymeric, and ceramic materials. Know their applications.

syllabus_topics: Equilibrium transformations in Fe-Fe3C and Fe-C diagrams
Aluminum, magnesium, and titanium alloys. Treatments. Applications.
Copper, brasses, and bronzes. Treatments. Applications.
Cu, Al, Mg, Ti and Ni alloys
Processing and treatment of ceramic materials
Processing and treatment of polymeric materials
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of 10% for group assignments, 10% for oral presentations, 10% for laboratory practical attendance and reports, and 70% for the course exam. The exam consists of a theory part and a practical (problems) part. To pass the course exam, a minimum grade of 5/10 must be achieved in both the theory and practical parts. The written exam is recoverable.
